question: U19 T20 Women's World Cup 2023 was organised by _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Africa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **U19 T20 Women's World Cup 2023** was hosted by **South Africa**, marking the inaugural edition of this tournament.
 
• The tournament was organized under the aegis of the **International Cricket Council (ICC)**.
 
• It took place from **January 14 to January 29, 2023**, featuring 16 teams from across the globe.
 
• India emerged as the **champions**, defeating England in the final to claim the title.
 
• The event was aimed at promoting young female cricket talent and providing a global platform for U19 players.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC Women's T20 World Cup:**

 
 
• The ICC Women's T20 World Cup is an international cricket championship organized by the ICC for women's national teams.
 
• It is a shorter-format tournament, typically held every two years, with matches lasting 20 overs per side.
 
• The first edition was held in 2009, and it has grown significantly in popularity since then.
 
 
 
• **South Africa as a Cricket Host:**
 
 
• South Africa is a prominent cricketing nation and has hosted several major ICC events, including the 2003 Men's Cricket World Cup.
 
• Its world-class stadiums, such as Newlands in Cape Town and Wanderers in Johannesburg, are known for their excellent facilities.
 
 
 
• **Importance of U19 Tournaments:**
 
 
• U19 tournaments are critical for identifying and nurturing young cricketing talent.
 
• They serve as a stepping stone for players aspiring to represent their countries in senior international cricket.
 
 
 
• **India's Victory in U19 Women's T20 World Cup 2023:**
 
 
• India's U19 Women's team, led by captain Shafali Verma, won the inaugural edition of the tournament.
 
• The victory was a significant milestone for women's cricket in India, inspiring young girls to take up the sport.
